company.name: DeepScribe
company.shortDescription: DeepScribe is an ambient, AI-powered medical scribe automates clinical documentation.
company.description:
DeepScribe is an AI-powered medical scribe platform that automates medical note taking for clinicians. DeepScribe uses AI, ML, and NLP to capture and transcribe natural clinical conversations in real time, extract relevant medical information, then classify it into a complete medical note. By combining AI with rules-based NLP and three speech recognition engines, DeepScribe is able to provide a fully automated, ambient solution for clinicians burdened by medical documentation.

With an easy-to-use mobile app and robust integrations with many popular EHR vendors, DeepScribe reimagines how documentation is captured and transforms how clinicians are able to deliver care.
